auto.actor_level_help: Compares the actor's current level. Between includes both limits.
auto.actor_scale_help: Changes this actor reference's scale. The final scale must remain between 0.10 and 10.00.
auto.actor_scale_percent_help: Percent is calculated from the external reference scale before EDF contributions.
auto.actor_value_percent_help: Percent is calculated from the external maximum value.
auto.actor_value_reward_persistent_help: If checked, the Actor Value modifier won't be removed when the rule becomes invalid.
auto.live_help: Recalculates the desired delta whenever EDF reevaluates this rule and applies only the difference from the previous delta.
auto.snapshot_help: Resolves the source once when the rule activates and keeps that exact applied delta until removal.
auto.source_multiplier_help: Multiplies the resolved source before Flat or Percent is calculated. 1 keeps it unchanged, 0.5 halves it, 2 doubles it, and -1 reverses its sign.
auto.combat_state_help: Controls whether the rule is valid in combat, out of combat, or both.
auto.duplicate_rule_hint: The copy starts disabled at version 0 and is written only when Save is pressed.
auto.follower_state_help: Active followers use CurrentFollowerFaction or compatible PlayerTeammate signals. The Player and summons do not count.
auto.hostility_to_player_help: Friendly / Ally means the actor is currently not hostile to the Player.
auto.converts_supported_distr_ini_entries_int: Converts supported *_DISTR.ini entries into EDF rules and creates a ZIP with EDF rules, patched SPID INI copies, and a report.
auto.creates_a_zip_file_in_data_viny_mods_edf: Creates a ZIP file in 'Data/Viny Mods/EDF/Export' with the correct folder structure.
auto.defines_how_the_plugin_handles_default_n: Defines how the plugin handles default NPC outfits when loading the game.
auto.detailed_report_inside_zip: Detailed line-by-line report is inside the ZIP as SPID_to_EDF_Report.txt.
auto.exclusive_groups_pick_only_one_group_fro: Exclusive Groups (Pick only one group from this rule)
auto.if_checked_item_won_t_be_removed_when_ru: If checked, item won't be removed when rule becomes invalid.
auto.name: Name
auto.no_items_found_in_this_category: No items found in this category.
auto.no_npcs_loaded_enter_the_game_to_populat: No NPCs loaded. Enter the game to populate the list.
auto.note_the_spid_equipment_system_may_not_w: Note: The SPID equipment system may not work correctly on NPCs with original Outfits.
auto.original_spid_inis_are_not_modified: Original SPID INIs are not modified; unsupported or unsafe SPID entries stay in the patched copies.
auto.package_delete_save_hint: The package and its rules will only be deleted when Save is pressed.
auto.review_zip_report_and_log_before_install: Review the ZIP report and EasyDistribution.log before installing the result.
auto.select_or_clear_entire_package: Select or clear every rule in this package.
auto.select_packages_and_rules_to_export: Select one or more packages and, inside each package, the rules to export. Package identities are preserved.
auto.select_rules_to_export_into_one_zip_pack: Select rules to export into one ZIP package.
auto.spid_to_edf_conservative_disclaimer: This conversion is conservative: wildcard/text rules such as *Mage, temporary dynamic keywords, Final entries, global/death linked entries, and random ranges may stay in SPID. Prefer exact EditorID/FormID/form filters when possible; text or location-style matching needs manual review.
auto.this_name_is_already_in_use: [!] This name is already in use
auto.this_npc_will_be_affected_by_unsaved_cha: This NPC will be affected by unsaved changes.
auto.zip_files_are_saved_to_data_viny_mods_ed: ZIP files are saved to Data/Viny Mods/EDF/Export.
